text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The night after the Debut race. Per Biwa 
Hayahide's request, we held a review 
session of the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide repeatedly analyzes race 
footage. It is clear that her "sister" is 
on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Formulating a formula to counter her 
"little sister" is a monumental task. What 
she needs right now is practical 
experience—facing off against even 
stronger contenders.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, their new goal was set on the 
Asahi Hai FS— a GⅠ race where the 
brightest talents of the Junior Class 
gather.
